title: Honua Sample Manifest v1
description: Schema for samples/<sample-id>/sample.json. Every runnable sample in this repo declares itself with one of these manifests; CI validates it on every PR (see scripts/validate-manifests.mjs).

id.description: Kebab-case identifier. MUST match the name of the containing samples/<sample-id>/ directory.

title.description: Short human-readable title shown in the gallery.

description.description: One or two sentences describing what the sample demonstrates.

capabilities.description: Dot-namespaced capability keys this sample exercises, e.g. 'serve.feature-service'. Every key must appear in the canonical capability key list (see schemas/fixtures/capability-keys.fixture.json and the KEY_LIST_URL indirection in .github/workflows/validate.yml).

sdks.description: Which SDK(s)/client style the sample uses. 'rest' means raw HTTP with no SDK package.

protocols.description: Wire protocols the sample talks, e.g. 'geoservices-rest', 'ogc-api-features'.

edition.description: Minimum Honua Server edition required to run this sample. Defaults to 'community' when omitted.

entrypoint.description: How the headless runner (scripts/run-samples.mjs) executes this sample.

command.description: Shell command run with the sample directory as the working directory.

status.description: 'active' samples are executed by the headless runner in CI/nightly. 'draft' samples are validated but not yet executed.
